description: User creation rules: valid input creates an active account; validation, duplicate email and unknown role are refused.

cases.inputs: FullName: "Nguyễn Thư Ký"; Email: "thuky@trustcabinet.local"; Password: "MatKhau@2026!"; RoleId: role "Thành viên".
cases.log: Account row added; audit row UserCreated (actor = admin, details { email, fullName, roleId, role } and no password); log "Account {UserId} created by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers; roles "Quản trị viên" and "Thành viên" exist.
No account uses the email thuky@trustcabinet.local.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG07) with the new account: active, role "Thành viên"; the password is stored only as a hash.
